annotations.title: Run a general England waste-rule preflight

description: FREE GENERAL ENTRY TOOL for a CURRENT England waste operation when the regulatory route is still uncertain. Provide nation, role, one or more modelled activities, and any known site/waste/authorisation facts. Returns a deterministic route, missing facts, findings, evidence and next actions; it is read-only and does not submit anything. Do NOT use when the question is specifically carrier/broker/dealer registration, DWT receiving-site readiness, or a current-vs-proposed permit change; use the corresponding narrow tool instead.

activities.description: One or more modelled activities. Do not invent waste codes or hazardous status from an activity label.
activities.title: Activities

authorisation_status.description: Current receiving/operator authorisation when known. Do not infer permit or exemption status.
authorisation_status.title: Authorisation Status

hazardous_status.description: Whether hazardous waste is involved, only when explicitly known from the user's facts; otherwise leave null.
hazardous_status.title: Hazardous Status

nation.description: UK nation for the operation. This service currently supports England only and never infers jurisdiction.
nation.title: Nation

role.description: Primary waste role. Use receiver/operator for sites taking or operating on waste; carrier/broker/dealer for movement or arranging roles.
role.title: Role

site_location.description: Site or sufficiently precise operating location in England when location matters to the route.
site_location.title: Site Location

waste_types.description: User-supplied waste types or codes. Do not infer EWC codes from free text.
waste_types.title: Waste Types

name: waste_rule_preflight
